name: Hydrogen, Electrolyser, and Fuel Cell Technology
description: Overview of hydrogen energy and its implementation and economics. Different routes of hydrogen generation: electrolysis versus reforming for hydrogen production, solar hydrogen. Different electrolysers and fuel cell technologies (alkaline, proton exchange membrane, and solid oxide electrolyser and fuel cells): low and high-temperature electrolysers and fuel cells. Electrolysers/fuel cell thermodynamics, reversibility, voltage and current efficiencies. Electrolyser/fuel cell reaction kinetics – electrode kinetics, overvoltages, exchange currents. Electrocatalysis - design, activation kinetics and electrode design - triple phase boundary, electrolyser/fuel cell charge and mass transport - transport in flow fields – bipolar plate and current collectors and their designs, different types of electrolytes and Ohmic overpotential. Electrolyser/fuel cell characterization- in-situ and ex-situ characterization techniques, i-V curve, application of voltammetry and frequency response analyses - diagnostics. Modeling and system integration and balance for the plant. Hydrogen storage and transportation, safety issues. Cost and life cycle analysis.
